newsitem.title: GERMANY: Civilian workers to strike at German US army base.
newsitem.headline: Civilian workers to strike at German US army base.

text.p: Some 600 civilians employed by the U.S. army in the town of Hanau near Frankfurt will go on strike from 0600 GMT on Monday for an unlimited period, the DAG white collar trade union said on Sunday.
The employees want the army to maintain jobs at the site and are demanding guarantees that they will receive compensation for any layoffs resulting from army cutbacks, the DAG said in a statement.
"In Hanau alone there is a danger that of the 600 remaining jobs a further 300 will be cut," the DAG said.
"We will accept no offer that further reduces existing obstacles to reducing jobs," Beatrix Mueller, a regional DAG official, said in the statement.
The DAG said it expected civilian employees at other military sites in the state of Hesse would also "defend themselves."
